controls.fullscreen_clips: Session generation, continuous navigation, background pause and stale callback denial.
controls.stories: Session/frame generations, partial progress receipts, interruption-safe pause/resume and expiry binding.
controls.search_relations: Privacy-filtered cursor pagination, duplicate denial and exact viewer/profile result binding.
controls.media_reads: Private no-store range reads with bounded single ranges and immediate relationship revocation.
controls.post_lifecycle: Owner/profile-bound edit, archive and withdrawal with immutable versions and transactional Outbox events.
controls.client_errors: Unified machine-readable offline/HTTP/retry contract with localized recovery keys.
controls.performance: Deterministic 400-post feed and explicit first-party transfer-size regression budgets.
controls.inventory: Reproducible Social integrity inventory V2 with 44/44 local source controls.

findings_resolved.problem: Late fullscreen and Story callbacks could mutate a newer viewer session.
findings_resolved.resolution: Session and frame generations now reject detached callbacks and pause safely in the background.

findings_resolved.problem: Post withdrawal had no immutable lifecycle record and archive/withdraw races lacked optimistic conflict checks.
findings_resolved.resolution: Version commitments, optimistic version predicates and transactional lifecycle Outbox events preserve history.

findings_resolved.problem: Search pagination applied its offset before privacy filtering and could repeat an item across pages.
findings_resolved.resolution: Privacy filtering now precedes pagination, with duplicate-free client validation on every page.

findings_resolved.problem: JSON and transport failures had inconsistent retry and localization metadata.
findings_resolved.resolution: The browser normalizes every result without overwriting domain status fields.
